1000 single-operator ST assignments with a REAL destination and two DINT operands. 1000 two-operator ST assignments with a DINT (integer) destination and no float anywhere. The CPT model prices integer and REAL destinations by completely different rules -- in float, operator TIER differences vanish and every non-float operand carries a conversion charge, neither of which applies to an all-integer expression. This is a real shape, not a curiosity: the corpus carries 44 SBR and 42 RET calls inside ST routines.
